name: season-ramp-south-mirror
description: Rest-season weight in the southern hemisphere at about 55 S on 2026-04-17: halfway up the ramp, 0.5 (the mirror of 17 October in the north).
why: Southern seasons are half a year off: the centre of full rest is 1 July. 1 July minus 17 April is 75 days: weight 0.5. Hand computation.
